title: Microsoft Windows Remote Desktop Gateway Service Null Pointer Dereference Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Microsoft Windows. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Remote Desktop Gateway service. The issue results from dereferencing a null pointer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial of service condition on remote desktop hosts behind the gateway.
